title: Hardcoded API secret in source code
description: API_SECRET is hardcoded as a string literal 'sk-prod-a1b2c3d4e5f6'. This secret will be committed to version control and exposed to anyone with repository access.

title: SQL injection via f-string interpolation
description: get_product builds a SQL query using an f-string with user-controlled product_id. Even though Flask's route converter provides an int, this pattern is unsafe if copied and sets a dangerous precedent.

title: Command injection via subprocess shell=True
description: search_products passes user-supplied query directly into a shell command string with shell=True. An attacker can inject arbitrary commands via the q parameter (e.g. q='; rm -rf /').

title: eval() on user-supplied filter expression
description: filter_products calls eval() on the filter_expr field from the request body, allowing arbitrary code execution on the server.

title: Mutable default argument in function signature
description: process_items uses a mutable default argument (items: list = []). The default list is shared across all calls, so items appended in one call persist into subsequent calls with no explicit argument.

title: open() without explicit encoding
description: import_csv opens a CSV file without specifying encoding='utf-8'. On platforms where the default encoding is not UTF-8 this can produce mojibake or raise UnicodeDecodeError.
